label: GO step after a common-transition unrewarded a2 trial (a2->S2, no reward), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), almost entirely when the previous trial was unrewarded (98% of mass) and was an a2 choice (83% of mass) that reached S2 by a common transition, which is the model-based switch-from-a2 situation; next_stay=0 has 4.2x lift. It is strongly gated by episode time: no activity before trial ~45, peaking at trials 70-89 and dropping at 90-99. It fires when the value is low-to-mid (5.2-7.1) and never when value > 7.7. It does not fire after rewarded trials, after a1 trials, or after rare transitions. Uses only observed history. Dev F1 0.55, mass recall 0.81; precision is about 0.45 because many matching GO steps stay silent (restricting to trials 60-89 raises precision to 0.61). About 15% of the mass is at the window first GO, where the previous trial lies outside the window, so the predicate cannot match it.
